scope: behavioral-DDR real RTL fixture; 29 DUT executions read from existing artefacts; audit75.py executes no RTL. run17/run21 are expected old route-not-bound terminal failures, not watchdog/deadlock and not full PASS. Seven invalid CLI attempts exit 2 before DUT construction and are excluded. Observed opportunities=0 is limited to this fixture; it is not a theoretical impossibility claim.
csv_beat_count_basis: CSV contains par/rfirst/rlast boundary rows only, not per-beat pr rows. R beat totals come from DUT/harness per-R handshake counters; CSV is used to verify accepted source bursts have real rfirst/rlast completions and that accepted PAR length sums match those counters.
attribution: DeepSeek authored the audit proposal; Codex performed root actual review, application and execution. This script does not execute RTL and does not modify RTL/CPP or old run data.
